title: Bedrockite Tools
description: This mod is an addon for Bedrockite that makes all the tools upgradeable to Bedrockite material.
body:
# Bedrockite Tools Addon

**Bedrockite Tools** is an addon for **Bedrockite** that introduces upgrading all the other tools into unstoppable Bedrockite variants.

## Features

* **Tool Upgrades:** Take your existing axes, hoes, shovels, and swords, and upgrade them using Bedrockite resources to unlock their ultimate potential.
* **Ultimate Durability & Efficiency:** Transform your everyday gear into tools that match the absolute strength and power of the Bedrockite tier.
* **Seamless Integration:** Works perfectly alongside the base Bedrockite mod, expanding your endgame options and survival progression.

---

## Dependecy

Bedrockite [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrockite)

---
